issues.desc: background.md uses M7 (and M9) as milestone identifiers without defining what M7/M9 represent (e.g., milestone 7 = powered study). The meaning is inferrable from context but a new reader must piece it together. Suggest adding a brief parenthetical on first use.

background.md line 5 uses the term "hosts" (as in "hosts improve fastest on well-attested patterns") without defining it. A new reader would not know whether host means the AI model instance, the human, or something else. Suggest inserting "(AI model hosts)" on first occurrence.

background.md cites "story B-beeb" as the M6 pilot story without a one-sentence explanation of what B-beeb is. Per Dimension 2 conventions, cross-story references should have a one-sentence context on first appearance.
